evals.prompt: I changed several files in the API app. What needs testing?
evals.expected_output: Analyzes git diff to classify changed files by test type needed. Generates a test plan with unit/integration/architecture/E2E sections. Identifies coverage gaps. Suggests /testing:write for gaps and /testing:run-e2e if UI/API changes exist.

evals.name: clean-tree-says-so-and-does-not-invent-gaps
evals.prompt: /testing:plan — working tree is clean and this branch matches the default branch. What needs testing?
evals.expected_output: Reads git status and the diff range, reports that there are no changed files to classify, and does not invent coverage gaps or a test list for unmodified code.
expectations: Inspects git status / the requested range rather than assuming files changed
Reports that there is nothing in the range to classify
Does not generate a unit/integration/E2E plan for unmodified files

evals.name: ui-change-routes-write-and-run-e2e
evals.prompt: I added a new settings page in the web app. /testing:plan
evals.expected_output: Classifies the UI change as needing unit or component tests plus E2E. Suggests /testing:write for the missing tests and /testing:run-e2e for the UI path, and does not treat a page change as unit-only.
expectations: Classifies the changed files as including a UI/E2E concern
Suggests /testing:run-e2e rather than stopping at unit tests
